environment: Ubuntu 26.04.1 LTS, Linux 7.0.0-43-generic x86_64 (a Linux machine, not WSL); PipeWire through pw-play; the ReleaseFast executable of .work/1181-linux/normal
how: The cases were played one after the other with --no-wait, in three groups; before each group the user was told what should be heard, and answered after it.

cases.expected: VOICE-HOLD, a moving pulse width: one low note for 3 s whose tone goes thin and full again once a second, smoothly; no clicks and no new attacks
VOICE-HOLD, a moving filter: one low saw for 3 s through a resonant low-pass that opens and closes once a second (wah-wah), smoothly; no clicks

groups.user_report: as described: smooth changes, no clicks and no new attacks

cases.expected: AMIGA-SOUND: the ping of case 16 as an instrument on C E G C through the A500 low-pass, then the same with AMIGA-FILTER on (the LED filter after it: duller)
NES-SHORT-NOISE: four hits of the ordinary noise (hiss), then four of the short mode (metallic, with a pitch)
NES-DMC: the ping of case 16 on voice 5 as the DMC on C E G C alone, then the same under a pulse melody

C64-FILTER: a saw C E G C plain; through the low-pass with resonance (dark, ringing); through the high-pass (thin); through the low-pass and band-pass together (dark, a little fuller than the low-pass)
STE-LEFT and STE-RIGHT: the ping of case 16 twice on the left, then twice on the right (a little sharp: its rate is one of 50066 / 1 to 8)
VOICE-PAN: C E G C on the left only, then on the right only, then in the middle (the same instrument each time)
AMIGA-SOUND, the voices' sides: four notes one after the other, C on the left, E on the right, G on the right, the high C on the left; then all four together

examples.user_report: no problem: no dropouts or distortion, spread to the left and right
no problem: no dropouts or distortion, spread to the left and right
no problem: every part as its printed line says, including the sides and reverb of the standard sound part, the NES drums and the Amiga sides

not_heard: examples/hopper.fs, shmup.fs, shmup-c64.fs, shmup-amiga.fs and try/ mario open a window and are played by a person; they were not run here. Case 25 (the NES triangle bass pitch) was not judged.
